_doc: TOUGE scripted playtest (Gordon). main.gd _run_touge_script: menu -> car select (player BRZ, rival S2000) -> START from the start grid (one behind the other, player trails; Touge passing 5c79dea: no role prompt, no turnout swap) -> 10 turns with per-phase passing -> finish. Picks are wanted stances (a locked gauge falls back to the first allowed); QTE = raw phase scores. pass_shots = how many visible passes to photograph (the first turns whose order flips).
